items.title: EMA closed on All Souls' Day, 2 November
items.summary: EMA’s office is closed on Monday 2 November, to mark All Souls' Day. The office reopens at 08:30 on Tuesday 3 November.The product emergency hotline is available outside…

items.title: Rezolute gets an uplift from phase 3 tumor hyperinsulinism win ahead of FDA meeting
items.summary: A phase 3 clinical trial of Rezolute’s ersodetug in tumor hyperinsulinism has hit its primary endpoint, boosting the biotech ahead of a potential filing for FDA approval in another indication.

items.title: Kyverna abandons next-gen autoimmune CAR-T once touted as follow-up to miv-cel
items.summary: Kyverna is halting work on a next-gen CD19 CAR-T therapy as the biotech seeks FDA approval for what could become the first CAR-T treatment for an autoimmune disease.

items.title: FDA cites record request breakdowns in trio of warning letters to API makers
items.summary: In a series of regulatory wrist-slaps now made public, the FDA has taken three manufacturers to task over record request breakdowns.

items.title: AMA and EMA issue joint guidance on Ebola vaccine development
items.summary: EMA’s Emergency Task Force (ETF) and the African Medicines Agency (AMA) have published a joint position paper to support the timely start of clinical trials for potential…

items.title: FDA rejects Summit’s ivonescimab, derailing US arrival of much-hyped PD-1xVEGF class
items.summary: The FDA has issued a complete response letter to Summit Therapeutics, derailing the immediate U.S. launch of a drug class that many industry heavyweights believe could eventually dethrone Merck & Co.’s Keytruda.

items.title: Chutes & Ladders—Bristol Myers' research chief out amid R&D reorganization
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb's research chief is departing as the company restructures R&D. Summit Therapeutics cut ties with multiple launch team members, including its CCO, ahead of a high-stakes FDA decision. And OncoNano appointed its interim chief, a former FDA commissioner, to the permanent CEO spot.

items.title: Virtuoso Surgical nabs FDA authorization for robotic bladder lesions system
items.summary: The FDA has granted De Novo authorization for Virtuoso Surgical’s Virtuoso Endoscopy System.

items.title: Regeneron posts positive phase 2 data for baloncibart in nervous system disorder, eyes pivotal trial
items.summary: Regeneron has posted positive phase 2 data on baloncibart in postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, teeing the biotech up to start a potentially pivotal trial in the first half of 2027.

items.title: FDA appears to pause controversial speedy review program, complete response letter disclosures
items.summary: The FDA has quietly shelved the Commissioner’s National Priority Voucher (CNPV) pilot program, Reuters reports. Meanwhile, the agency also appears to have paused publishing complete response letters after briefly halting—and then resuming—the practice in July.

items.title: BioNTech pays $205M for FDA voucher to speed up ‘late-stage oncology pipeline’
items.summary: BioNTech has agreed to pay $205 million to purchase an FDA priority review voucher to support a future filing of a drug in its “late-stage oncology pipeline.” Fierce breaks down which candidate is most likely to claim the regulatory accelerator.

items.title: Europe's CHMP backs Baxfendy, gives Hansoh's Aumseqa another chance
items.summary: Amid a slate of regulatory decisions this week, the CHMP backed AstraZeneca's Baxfendy and endorsed Hansoh's application for Aumseqa after revoking its original marketing authorization earlier this summer.

items.title: Pharmas should stay agile as Democrats amp up scrutiny over Trump's MFN deals
items.summary: Industry experts are calling for pharma leaders to ready for heavier oversight as a newly blue Congress demands an unredacted look at President Trump's controversial MFN drug pricing deals.

items.title: Regulatory tracker: Lilly beats Novo to land China's 1st oral GLP-1 weight loss nod
items.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

items.title: Charles River pays $470M for 2 Frontage bioanalysis labs in Pennsylvania
items.summary: Charles River Laboratories has acquired Tigermed’s Frontage laboratory sites for $470 million upfront to advance its bioanalysis footprint.

items.title: Valo and Montai become one as the Flagship AI-based biotechs tie the knot
items.summary: Two Flagship Pioneering-founded AI drug discovery and development biotechs, Valo Health and Montai Therapeutics, will join forces in a merger that aims to advance Montai’s early-stage and preclinical pipeline as well as continue a series of big-name partnerships already in tow.

items.title: The promise of molecular gates and what comes next
items.summary: Gate Bioscience is developing a new class of medicines designed to eliminate disease-causing proteins at their source. In this episode of "The Top Line," Gate co-founder and CEO Jordi Mata-Fink, Ph.D., discusses the promise of molecular gates, the biotech's expanded partnership with Eli Lilly and its plans to bring the technology into the clinic.

items.title: Cellectis will shed 70% of workforce as part of in vivo pivot
items.summary: Cellectis’ pivot from allogeneic CAR-Ts to in vivo therapies is set to come at the expense of 70% of its workforce.

items.title: ‘They’ve been misdiagnosed for too long’: Researchers use 10-protein panel to improve ALS detection
items.summary: By the time a neurodegenerative condition has been diagnosed, it's often too late. At the point of detection, the disease may already be causing irreversible damage, fueling an urgent search for ways to identify biological clues earlier and track their progression.

items.title: American Cancer Society updates prostate cancer screening guidance
items.summary: For the first time in 16 years, the American Cancer Society (ACS) has updated its guideline for prostate cancer screening as it drives to boost detection of the disease before it spreads.

items.title: Sanofi-backed Windward hits $225M IPO goal, as Rezera delays listing over ‘market conditions’
items.summary: Windward Bio’s IPO has blown to exactly the spot the Swiss biotech had been aiming for, bringing in $225 million to fund a pair of respiratory drugs licensed from China.

items.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Milestone shrinks HQ workforce during Cardamyst rollout
items.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

items.title: ARPA-H bets $4.9 million on ibogaine for PTSD treatment in veterans
items.summary: The U.S. department of health and human services announced a $4.9 million bet to advance the development of ibogaine for post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).

items.title: Vor pays RemeGen $10M for long-acting addition to autoimmune pipeline
items.summary: Vor Bio is paying RemeGen $10 million upfront in cash for rights to RC298 outside Greater China, adding a long-acting drug candidate to its BAFF/APRIL franchise.

items.title: Why a fresh approach to targeting G protein-coupled receptors could treat a rare eye cancer
items.summary: Researchers found that only by targeting both the G protein-coupled receptor and its mutated internal molecular switch can uveal melanoma cell signaling be disrupted.

items.title: BMS reunites R&D divisions under Cristian Massacesi, while Robert Plenge departs
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb is merging its research and development divisions under the leadership of Cristian Massacesi, M.D.

items.title: Pfizer taps Blackstone for up to $1.5B to pave path to GLP-1's obesity launch
items.summary: Pfizer has secured up to $1.5 billion from Blackstone Life Sciences to fund development of its monthly GLP-1 receptor agonist.

items.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: China's Eli Radiopharma raises $60M; Neurosterix notches $105M
items.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.

items.title: Addex spinout Neurosterix raises $105M series B to fund phase 2 schizophrenia trial
items.summary: Addex Therapeutics’ neuropsychiatric-focused spinout has raised $105 million in series B funds to bankroll a planned phase 2 study of its schizophrenia treatment.

items.title: Rivia launches AI-powered clinical trial data review module, with Scancell as early adopter
items.summary: Swiss data engine Rivia has launched a new AI-powered data review module to speed up clinical data cleaning.

items.title: Could we see 10 Chinese Big Pharmas within a decade? Some CEOs think so
items.summary: For executives at many of the Chinese drug developers who spoke to Fierce, the real prize is a seat at the Big Pharma table. In recent years, this objective has moved from a vague aspiration to a concrete goal.

items.title: Genentech brings every day wins to life in patient-focused Hemlibra push
items.summary: New videos for Genentech’s “Life Doesn’t Wait” campaign showcase real patients and their families as they prove that their rare disease doesn't stop them from everyday life.

items.title: AstraZeneca cuts 600 US sales jobs amid $1.5B savings plan: Bloomberg
items.summary: AstraZeneca’s $1.5 billion cost-savings drive has started to take a toll on its U.S. workforce. The British pharma has cut about 600 jobs from its respiratory and immunology commercial teams in the U.S., Bloomberg reports.

items.title: AZ keeps pressure on Keytruda with Imfinzi expansion in chemo-ineligible bladder cancer
items.summary: Looking to challenge a preeminent Keytruda cocktail in cisplatin-ineligible muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC), AstraZeneca has crossed the finish line with its own doublet wedding Pfizer and Astellas’ Padcev with its PD-L1 inhibitor Imfinzi.

items.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Foundayo, Wegovy pill keep scripts on the ascent
items.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

items.title: Teva CEO 'proud' of pipeline buzz as innovative-generics hybrid rolls out 1st R&D day
items.summary: While acknowledging that Teva’s peak sales estimate for its tranche of late-stage pipeline darlings may be verging on “aspirational,” at least one analyst team walked away from the company’s first R&D investor confab this week feeling “increasingly confident” in the firm’s direction.

items.title: Bavarian Nordic C-suite stability in question as CFO steps down amid Q3 beat
items.summary: As Bavarian Nordic’s new CEO Tarja Stenvall makes her debut, CFO Henrik Juuel is stepping down.
